ruleDefinitions.name: Tamper With Sophos AV Registry Keys
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects tamper attempts to sophos av functionality via registry key modification Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: ((registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Sophos\\ Endpoint\\ Defense\\\\TamperProtection\\\\Config\\\\SAVEnabled.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Sophos\\ Endpoint\\ Defense\\\\TamperProtection\\\\Config\\\\SEDEnabled.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Sophos\\\\SAVService\\\\TamperProtection\\\\Enabled.*")) AND Details = "DWORD\ \(0x00000000\)")
